One day, while out and about
with Ines Fujin...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Paka Petit!
They're all so cute~.

text_block_list.text: Ines Fuujin was gazing at a crane game filled with plushies styled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My little sisters beg me all the time, too,
but I'm really bad at crane games... Ahaha."
